scope: PDF Tools v2 end to end: in a hidden OctoSense desktop shell built from this branch (debug, macOS, Apple silicon) with the real pdf engine in the app's own storage, and in App Hub's card-host without host services (the shipped bundle, and a scratch copy with the dev fixture at the designs' size). Every engine call in the shell runs was real.
base: 3bd15bad161f44d6110da4d3374ecfb17c615fef (main with #472, the pdf service v2); the sources below are this pull request's

shell.runtime: the root's .sources: makepad d653bc44 with runtime-patches tree 3f4fd959 (35 stacked patches), Octoscript-Makepad 6cf2d90a, Octoscript 2e37d9e6
shell.launch: a Terminal.app tab (osascript) under the machine's shell-run lock, one OctoSense at a time: OCTOSENSE_HOME=<fresh home> OCTOS_APP_CORE_DIR=<home>/octos-home/.octos MAKEPAD_HOME=<home>/makepad MAKEPAD_HIDE_WINDOWS=1 MAKEPAD_REMOTE=127.0.0.1:8915 MAKEPAD_WM_TEST_APP=pdftools; ended with /quit
shell.window: the shell's default app window: 990 x 603 points in a 1400 x 898 window (2x)

card_host.app_hub_revision: 8347a489141c0e24cab564883db7c4592935a8b2 (an ancestor of the shell's pin; the pin adds only the services' isolate-closed hook, catalog data and docs)
card_host.script_budget: missing: the runtime's 64 ms; fixture: MAKEPAD_SPLASH_BUDGET_MS=1000 (script_budgets)

commands: the shell runs again with --budget-ms 1000 while other builds loaded the machine (passed; frames not kept)
hub stamp <copy of apps/pdftools/bundle>; hub check <copy> --system-app

frames: the app's window cut from each shell grab by its sidecar's area (one pixel per point); card-host grabs halved; side-by-side sheets halved (card-host) or at the shell's height, reduced to 256 colours (PIL)

runs.shell: the samples in the shell's default window, light, then dark through the shell's style menu (OctoSense · Dark), the dark pass on what the light pass left
runs.restart: the same home again, with Imported PDF.pdf (pdftools_fixture --import-sample) placed in the library between the runs
runs.full: a fresh home whose storage was filled to 8 KB short of 64 MiB
runs.empty: a fresh home with no PDFs, light then dark
runs.missing: card-host, the shipped bundle, the samples, MAKEPAD_WIDGET_STYLE=macos; no host services
runs.fixture: card-host, a scratch copy of the bundle with dev-fixture/engine.splash in place of engine(), make_fixture.py's documents, 1536 x 1024, macos then macos-dark

checks: Home lists the samples with the engine's first pages ('2 pages · 6 KB', 'Not opened yet'), the damaged one as 'Couldn't open this PDF', and '37 KB of 64 MB used'
Open a PDF from this device: files.import is refused with 'foreground_required: Return to this app before choosing or sharing a file' (a hidden window never has focus), and the app shows it in a card
The report opens at 100% in the 990-point window with its thumbnails; page 2 from its thumbnail reads '2 / 4'
Find 'revenue': '9 matches on 4 pages', results by page with the match in bold, '1 of 9', the match highlighted on page 1; the page refits to 95% while the results panel is open

Comment: 'Comment as' is asked once and 'Maya Chen' kept; the pill's next goes to page 2; a tap on the Summary's first line adds a highlight from pdf.lines' box (the count goes 0 to 1, and 1 to 2 in the dark pass); the thread shows MC, Maya Chen; a reply on an empty highlight becomes its text; the right panel is 320 points and the page fits at 89%
Pages: page 2 chosen and turned right (its tile turns landscape), then Undo turns it back

Combine: Board minutes added with the range '1' ('(1 page)', 'One PDF of 5 pages'); Combine writes 'Quarterly report combined.pdf' ('… combined 2' in the dark pass) and opens it ('Combined into “Quarterly report combined”, 5 pages.')
Fill & Sign: the lease has no form fields; Add initials places 'MC' beside clause 3 (kept for the dark pass); Edited
Edit: clause 1 in the editor (Paragraph 4, 'Times-Roman · 11 pt'), ' (amended)' typed and applied; the page re-renders with the edit; Save says Saved (a plain save works from the hidden shell)
Damaged scan reads 'Couldn't open this PDF' with the engine's own message
The shell's style switch to dark re-runs the script and keeps the tabs, the name, the initials and the edits (#440)
After a restart: Imported PDF opens (3 pages); the report reopens at page 2; the saved lease's cover shows its initials
With 8 KB left: 'PDF Tools' storage is full' on Home (no cover can be written); removing a PDF asks 'Remove it from PDF Tools' storage?', then 'Removed “Apartment lease.pdf” from PDF Tools.'
No PDFs: 'No PDFs here yet' with Open a PDF from this device, light and dark, then the refusal
card-host without services: 'This device has no PDF engine' and 'Not available here'
card-host with the dev fixture: the nine designed screens, light and dark, beside their designs; the damaged, protected and unsaved states
No [E], on_render, callback or script-budget error lines in any shell or card-host log
not_verified: the host's file dialog and what follows a real import: a hidden window cannot open it (the files service refuses first)
form fields with the real engine: no sample PDF has a form (pdf.fields, pdf.fill and the field overlays ran only on the dev fixture)

with the real engine, only highlight and reply/edit of the comment operations, only rotate and Undo of the page operations, and no Redo, outline (the samples have none), password-protected PDF, eight-open cap or close-with-unsaved-changes dialog; the dev fixture covers their screens
window sizes other than the shell's default 990 x 603 and card-host's 1536 x 1024

behaviour on a heavily loaded machine: in earlier rounds (before library.json moved off the tap path), at load averages of 60 to 150, the tap that opens a PDF overran the 64 ms budget twice and was lost; the runs kept here ran at load 10 to 30, and the same runs passed with MAKEPAD_SPLASH_BUDGET_MS=1000 at load 45 to 117
script_budgets: shell runs and missing: the runtime's 64 ms (load average 10 to 30). fixture: MAKEPAD_SPLASH_BUDGET_MS=1000, because its stand-in engine answers in script (it reads and parses the fixture's JSON): at 64 ms its journey passed, but one stand-in answer overran in the dark pass. The real engine answers natively.
